verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GA4 supports a User-ID for cross-device identification (required for cross-device remarketing) and has Reporting identity settings that the Data API respects. Cross-device understanding is also marketed. Nothing documents how a developer sets the User-ID, and nothing shows anonymous pre-signup activity being merged or stitched into the identified user. missing for 10: documented merging of anonymous pre-signup events into the identified profile, developer docs for setting user_id across web/app/Measurement Protocol, explanation of how Reporting identity stitches devices, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify users across devices and merge anonymous pre-signup activity into their identified profile

citations.quote: Para o remarketing entre dispositivos, é necessário usar um User-ID.
